title: Earnings Per Share—Financial Instruments and Other Contracts that May Be Settled in Shares
summary: Addressed how to treat contracts that may be settled in shares or cash when computing diluted EPS, establishing a rebuttable presumption of share settlement. Withdrawn in 2003.

related.title: Earnings Per Share
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-24 by incorporating the share-settlement presumption directly into the diluted EPS calculation guidance
